questions.stem: What is the period of y = sin(x)?
questions.explanation: The sine function completes one full cycle every 360 degrees.

questions.stem: What is the maximum value of y = 3sin(x)?
questions.explanation: sin(x) has maximum value 1. So 3sin(x) has maximum value 3 x 1 = 3.

questions.stem: How many solutions does sin(x) = 0.5 have for 0 <= x <= 360 degrees?
questions.explanation: sin(x) = 0.5 gives x = 30 degrees and x = 150 degrees (in the first and second quadrants). Two solutions.

questions.stem: The period of y = tan(x) is:
questions.explanation: The tangent function repeats every 180 degrees, unlike sin and cos which repeat every 360 degrees.

questions.stem: For y = cos(x), what is the value when x = 180 degrees?
questions.explanation: cos(180) = -1. This is the minimum value of the cosine function.
